author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
You only need 4 things to build your own workforce of AI agents from scratch 

1. Claude Code or Codex with unlimited tokens
2. A way to let CC/Codex to read/send your emails or messages 
3. uv
4. npm

I automated 80% of my day to day work starts with these 4 things, turning one human action into AI skill at a time.  Soon before I realized, the bumpy dirt road became a highway.
